name: Animated Counter
description: Provides animated number counters with scroll trigger.
library_dependencies: Font Awesome 6.5.0 (loaded from cdnjs CDN by the counter library)
project_description: Animated Counter provides a configurable block that displays one or more "count-up" number tiles which animate from 0 to a target value when scrolled into view. Each tile is defined in the block's own configuration form (a draggable table) with a numeric value, optional suffix (%, +, K, etc.), label, Font Awesome icon class, icon color, optional link URL, and per-tile animation duration. Block-level options control the column layout (auto / 2 / 3 / 4), a style preset (card / bordered / minimal), a background gradient preset, an optional click ripple effect, an optional rich-text block of content shown above the tiles, and a custom wrapper CSS class. The count-up is driven client-side by js/counter.js using IntersectionObserver (fires once the tile is 40% visible) and requestAnimationFrame; a live preview inside the admin form is rendered by js/admin-preview.js. The module ships no config entities, no config schema, no routes, no permissions, and no services beyond the single block plugin; it depends on core Block and on the contrib block_animate module (auto-installed on enable).
